newsitem.title: THAILAND: Capetronic to issue 15.8 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Capetronic to issue 15.8 mln new shares.

text.p: Capetronic International (Thailand) Plc said on Thursday it will issue 15.8 million new shares to raise 158 million baht.
It said it will concurrently issue 63 million units of warrants.

Capetronic made the announcement as part of a rehabilitation plan after the company was told it was in danger of being delisted by the stock exchange because its net tangible net asset value had fallen below 50 percent of its issued capital.

The new shares will be offered through a rights issue at the ratio of one new share for every 15 existing shares at 10 baht per rights share, the company said. Four units of warrants will be attached to each new share offered to exising shareholders, it added.
The rights issue will be made by the end of April 1997, Capetronic said. After the rights issue, the company's number of registered shares will rise to 253 million.
Capetronic said it may also reduce its capital after the rehabilitation is achieved, but this would not be done before 1998 and would not be more than 25 percent of its issued capital.
The Stock Exchange of Thailand has approved the rehabilitation plan, Capetronic said.
